outcome.answer: For graph machine learning applied to chemical reactions, RxnCLF uses a condensed reaction graph to learn transformation-aware representations and improve reaction-yield prediction over graph and sequence baselines [1]. enviGraph generates reaction data from transformation rules and uses a graph-to-sequence predictor for biodegradation products and pathways [6]. These address different tasks: reaction representation and yield prediction [1], versus biodegradation prediction [6].
